name: Crucias
description: An unscrupulous ship's captain who survives the Sylex Blast and later ascends as the planeswalker Bo Levar.

description_citations.text: "The Colors of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crucias's passengers witness the Sylex Blast; everyone on deck dies except Crucias, who is blinded.
timeline.quote: Everyone on deck dies except Crucias himself, who is blinded by the blast.

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Expeditions to the End of the World , by J. Robert King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Crucias and Elgia survive; Crucias later ascends as the planeswalker Bo Levar.
timeline.quote: Crucias would later ascend as a planeswalker and change his name to Bo Levar .

citation.text: "The Colors of Magic", section "Expeditions to the End of the World , by J. Robert King". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
